title: vat completion record, version 1
description: One unit of work that crossed a repository boundary: which revisions were verified together, what proved it, and the way back. Normative prose is docs/SPEC.md section 6; where the two disagree, SPEC.md is the specification and this file has a bug.

id.description: Identifies the record and names its file.

integration_acceptance.description: What proved the repositories work together, as opposed to each one working alone.

repositories.description: The revision bundle. A record with one participant is a git commit with extra steps.

landing_waived.description: Records a deliberate decision that this work is complete without reaching a shipping branch, so that an unlanded record is either explained or reported.

participant.description: One repository's part in the work, and the evidence for it.

rollback_point.description: The revision to return to. Recorded before the change, because afterwards nobody can tell which commit was the last good one.

landed_on.description: The shipping branch this participant reached. Absent means the work is recorded but not shipped.

check.description: A command that was run and what it returned. Evidence is a command and its result, not an assertion that someone tested it.
